items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $135 from $230 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares. Lithium price is up about 67% year over year but below all-time highs; supply and demand trends appear poised to improve into 2027.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $175 from $200 at BMO Capital
items.snippet: BMO Capital analyst Joel Jackson lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $175 from $200 and keeps an Outperform rating, lowering lithium company targets after recent spot price weakness while viewing the group as oversold.

items.headline: Albemarle (NYSE:ALB): Is the Lithium Cycle Turning? - Kalkine Media
items.snippet: Albemarle is back on the market's radar, with lithium pricing and energy storage demand shaping the conversation.

items.headline: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold ALB Stock After a 29% Dip in 6 Months?
items.snippet: Albemarle shares have tumbled 29.1% in the past six months as lithium prices declined amid softer China EV demand, elevated inventory and expected supply increases.
